vesperin.desc: MINI-BOSS Lord Vesperin (3x, O5): long black coat over a wine waistcoat + belted trousers, red-lined cape, red-lit eyes; NO plate. Mist-bat split = vesperin_bat.

vesperin_bat.desc: Vesperin's mist-bat (x3 at 50%): violet mist bat (palette blue-shadow); only the real one has hh_shadow.

odric.desc: Ser Odric Gravemantle (defiant mini-boss 3x): Gloam Knight, dark leather jerkin + violet tabard, greatsword; NO plate; yields at 25%.

gravelamp.desc: gravelamp (rare 2x): grave lantern elder, spits cold-fire wisps.

hollowchoir.desc: hollowchoir (rare 3x): chorus of fused wraiths in a column (violet = fx), dirge aura.
